POLICY BENCH / RESEARCH PROTOTYPE
SIMULATION · SCRIPTED POLICY

Robotic policy stress testing.

This prototype runs 200 MuJoCo trials, adaptively explores gripper–object friction, and identifies a sharp transition in grasp success. Inspect individual trajectories, uncertainty intervals, and reproducibility metadata below.

Current demo: a scripted policy controlling an idealized gripper on a cube pick-and-place task.

Conditional verdict

These trials characterize this scripted policy and idealized gripper in simulation. They do not certify real-world deployment. Other variation axes, interactions, and the sim-to-real gap remain unassessed.

Failures are classified using object height, motion, final position, and contact forces. These are diagnostic heuristics.

The overall rate would be biased by adaptive oversampling near the boundary, so it is not used as a verdict.
